# Waveshare audio PIO

Only `audio_pio.pio` remains from Waveshare RP2350-Touch-LCD-1.54, commit `51a7fe28c1e5dd19a089a062980a275709e94df6`, examples/C/02_ES8311. [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE) retained. The ES8311 C/header and compatibility shims were removed because of the C file's product-restricted license. Current codec implementation and provenance: [Espressif Apache adaptation](../espressif_es8311/README.md). Historical Git objects and older release assets are not rewritten.
